run_config_command: run the accelerate config command to interactively create and save a default_config.yaml for your training system
build_config_parser: build an argparse subparser for the accelerate config command with a --config_file option
create_config_file: create an accelerate configuration file by answering prompts about compute environment and cluster settings
summarize_get_user_input: summarize the get_user_input function that prompts for compute environment and returns a config object
review_config_command: review the config_command function that saves the interactive config to YAML or JSON
